description: This file implements a FileWatcher class for monitoring file system events, processing file changes, and managing batch operations including parsing, embedding, and vector store updates within a VSCode extension environment.

classes.name: FileWatcher
classes.description: A class implementing file system watching, event handling, and batch processing for code indexing within a VSCode extension.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up the file system watcher and event handlers.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources and event subscriptions.

methods.name: scheduleBatchProcessing
methods.description: Debounces and schedules batch processing of accumulated events.

methods.name: triggerBatchProcessing
methods.description: Initiates processing of batched file events.

methods.name: processBatch
methods.description: Processes a batch of file events, including deletions, parsing, embedding, and vector store updates.

methods.name: processFile
methods.description: Processes an individual file: checks ignore rules, size, content changes, and generates embedding points.

methods.name: _handleBatchDeletions
methods.description: Handles deletion of files from vector store and cache.

methods.name: _processFilesAndPrepareUpserts
methods.description: Parses files, creates embedding points, and prepares data for vector store upsert.

methods.name: _executeBatchUpsertOperations
methods.description: Performs batch upsert of embedding points into vector store with retries and telemetry.

methods.name: updateBatchSegmentThreshold
methods.description: Updates the batch segment size parameter.
